text:
oncall-bot: PAGER — GPU nodepool capacity exhausted in prod-west. Queue growth > 85% for inference requests across /v1/generate. Autoscaler failing to attach new GPU nodes. Paging oncall.

emily: pinging infra. I see elevated 429s and token queues rising on the console. Is this the same autoscaler taint issue we saw last month?

raj: seeing a bunch of errors from the cluster-autoscaler: "failed to scale up: unable to find nodegroup with matching launch template/profile or attach role denied". Posting recent logs: 
```
E0321 14:03:12.345 autoscaler.go:224] scaleup: provider returned error: AttachRoleDenied: action "ec2:RunInstances" denied for iam role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/gpu-provisioner
status code: 403
```

kevin: hmm. The launch template version pinned in the nodegroup is outdated vs the image we're trying to use. Also IAM passrole on the autoscaler service account shows missing permission on the new instanceprofile. Could be a rollout timing issue from last night.

sophie: console shows Dedicated GPU pool is at 100% reserved. We have two things to confirm: (1) ASG max size hit? (2) API rate limit to EC2/ASG?

raj: checked ASG: min=2 desired=8 max=8. We're at 8. So autoscaler can't exceed the max. ASG hadn't been expanded when demand spiked.

emily: that's consistent — queue growth because no capacity headroom. For mitigation: can we temporarily increase ASG max and trigger manual scale up?

kevin: I can bump ASG max to 12, but need confirmation from ops-sre for safety. Also need to patch the attach role permission before new instances boot or they'll fail to join.

ops-sre: give me 2 mins. Quick checklist: (A) bump ASG max, (B) ensure instance profile exists and attach-policy allows PassRole for the autoscaler SA, (C) ensure launch template has correct AMI and taints.

autoscaler-bot: NOTE: cluster-autoscaler has reported repeated node taint rejections: 
```
NodeProvisioner: instance failed to join: taint mismatch: expected taint gpu=true:NoSchedule, got taint gpu_reserved=true:NoSchedule
```

raj: that taint mismatch is from a recent change — new infra rollout introduced gpu_reserved taint to keep some nodes for batch. Autoscaler still expecting gpu=true. Need template update or autoscaler config override.

kevin: propose immediate mitigations:
- Manual ASG max bump to 12 (temporary).
- Patch IAM passrole to allow ec2:RunInstances/iam:PassRole for autoscaler SA.
- Temporarily relax taint constraint in kube provisioner to accept both tags OR remove the new taint from the template.
- Route a subset of traffic to CPU-quantized model variant as a fallback (lower perf but keeps customers alive).

emily: doing customer impact triage: current service-level error is 10–15% of requests 429/503 for premium tenants in prod-west. Non-critical jobs are queued; we're blocking some interactive latency-sensitive requests. I'll draft a brief for support.

sophie: I've opened a console ticket to throttle non-interactive batch users and created scaling policy override. ops-sre, can you approve ASG change now?

ops-sre: Approved. BumpingASG -> setting max=12, desired=10. Applying now.

autoscaler-bot: Action: ASG max updated to 12 by ops-sre. Triggering new instance launches.

raj: while instances spin up, I pushed a temporary patch to the launch template to remove gpu_reserved taint and revert to gpu=true. New instances will join as GPU nodes. Pushed change ID lt-0a1b2c3d.

kevin: IAM note: applied iam:PassRole for role/gpu-provisioner to autoscaler-sa via the cluster-role-binding patch. Please verify.

emily: support note: letting customers know we're scaling up and routing fallback options. Sending short status to account teams in 5.

autoscaler-bot: New instances launched. 3/4 nodes reached Ready. kubelet join logs: 
```
kubelet: Node gpu-03 joined. Labels: node.kubernetes.io/instance-type=p4d. Taints: gpu=true:NoSchedule. Applied labels: redwood/gpu=true
```

sophie: traffic starting to drop from queue, token processing rate increasing. 429s decreased from 14% -> 4% in the last 8m.

kevin: remediation follow-ups: we'll need a durable fix: (1) reconcile launch template versions with autoscaler config, (2) add ASG headroom during peak windows or enable burst capacity, (3) add preflight CI validating taints/IAM for new templates, (4) update runbook for temporary CPU-model fallback routing. I'll make a ticket.

emily: on-call handoff: I'm staying through the next 2 hours to stabilize, then Raj will take over for post-incident cleanup and the customer write-up. @raj you okay for handoff?

raj: yes. I'll take the 2–6pm slot. Will run postmortem template, include timeline and infra change that introduced gpu_reserved.

ops-sre: Closing immediate pager: autoscaler functional, queue dropping, customer-visible errors under target. Recommend incident severity -> SEV2 -> move to retrospective.

sophie: filing a short incident summary for #postmortems and tagging platform/product.

emily: quick checklist items we agreed on: 
- Postmortem with timeline and root cause (launch-template + ASG max) [owner: raj]
- IaC PR to reconcile launch template versions and add taint compatibility tests [owner: kevin]
- Add pre-approved burst ASG policy for prod-west [owner: ops-sre]
- Account-facing status note and follow-up with affected tenants [owner: emily]

kevin: also adding an automated smoke test that simulates a sudden 30% GPU queue spike during PR gating for launch templates.

autoscaler-bot: Incident update: PAGER cleared at 3005000900. Follow-up items logged.

emily: thanks everyone. I'll post the short customer message and move this to postmortem flow. :thumbsup:

raj: leaving a note — no direct evidence of compromised credentials; this was a rollout mismatch. We'll include rollback options in future.

ops-sre: marking runbook updated  — added section for ASG emergency bump and taint mismatch checklist.

sophie: closing thread for now. If anything regresses ping @oncall.
